class Point {
  constructor(public { x, y }: { x: number; y: number }) {}
}
class Pair {
  constructor(public first: number, private [second]: number[]) {}
}
class Box {
  constructor(public value: number);
  constructor(public value: number) {}
}
function describe(readonly label: string): string {
  return label;
}
const shape = { scale(protected factor: number) {} };
class Circle {
  constructor(readonly radius: number) {}
}
console.log(new Circle(2).radius);
